assertion: Since the turn of the millennium, its cattle herd has more than doubled while hog counts have tripled.
inaccuracy: The claim says hog counts tripled since 2000; NASS shows 33,500 hogs in Gratiot in Dec 2000 and a Census 2022 figure of about 82,000 (2.4x), peaking near 139,000 in 2012; tripling holds only against 1990s levels (about 20,000). Cattle more than doubled (24,500 to 60,000) as claimed.
warehouse_value: cattle 24,500 (2000) to 60,000 (2025); hogs 33,500 (2000) to ~82,000 (Census 2022, fragmented rows summed)
sql: SELECT "year", source_desc, value FROM ag.nass_livestock_inventory WHERE county_fips='26057' AND commodity_desc='HOGS' AND class_desc='ALL CLASSES'

assertion: The Pine is among some three-quarters of Michigan's rivers and streams polluted by levels of human and animal waste that exceed state water quality standards and may sicken thousands of residents per year.
warehouse_value: ATTAINS 2026 cycle, Michigan RIVER, Total Body Contact Recreation: 28,104 miles Not Supporting vs 4,714 Fully Supporting = 86% of assessed miles (39% of 71,283 total miles); all causes, so consistent with a waste-only 75%
sql: SELECT reporting_cycle, attainment_category, SUM(size) FROM environment.attains_state_use_summary WHERE organization_id='21MICH' AND water_type='RIVER' AND use_name='Total Body Contact Recreation' GROUP BY 1,2
reason: Estimate; the warehouse figure is consistent with it.

assertion: There are now 272 regulated CAFOs in Michigan, each with a minimum of 1,000 cattle, 700 dairy cows, 80,000 laying hens or 2,500 pigs.

independent_value: EPA: 1,000 cattle, 700 mature dairy, 2,500 swine over 55 lb, 82,000 laying hens
